command:
Set-Location 'E:/OptoJump/IronJump-gil-pause-control-20261019-01'
if((Get-FileHash plan01.json).Hash.ToLower() -ne 'eb0283dc907ec402813246d3bdf7626b1e62e3b099bd2630f71af1e8eaaf710b'){throw 'Plan mismatch'}
$active=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'observer.exe'})
if($active.Count){throw 'Existing Python/observer processes; no start'}
$helper='E:/OptoJump/IronJump-gil-timestamped-20261018-01/field01/experiments/native_stack_capture'
New-Item -ItemType Directory frozen_helpers|Out-Null
Copy-Item "$helper/observe.py","$helper/winapi.py" frozen_helpers
Copy-Item 'E:/OptoJump/IronJump-gil-observer-noise-20261018-01/observer.exe' observer.exe
@{plan_sha=(Get-FileHash plan01.json).Hash.ToLower();observer_sha=(Get-FileHash observer.exe).Hash.ToLower();observe_sha=(Get-FileHash "$helper/observe.py").Hash.ToLower();winapi_sha=(Get-FileHash "$helper/winapi.py").Hash.ToLower();processes_before=$active;utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content pre_capture01.json -Encoding UTF8
& D:/conda/python.exe control.py *> controller.log
$code=$LASTEXITCODE
@{controller_exit=$code;utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
if($code -ne 0){throw 'Control failed; preserve logs, locks and all output'}
